title: Ontology
description: model/ontology.json: object types, links and action types over model.json's tables, keys and relationships (defined there once) and measures.json's measures. Changed only by confirmed ABI actions.

base.description: IRI base for the RDF/JSON-LD export; default urn:abi:<project>:

table.description: a keyed, visible model table; its key is the object's identity

title.description: the column shown as the object's name

measures.description: measure IDs shown per object, filtered to it

column.description: a column of the object's table, or table.column of a table one-to-one with it

via.description: relationship IDs walked from `from`'s table to `to`'s table, each along or against its many-to-one direction

default.description: semantic_query reaches `to`'s table this way when several ways exist

rls.description: row-level security: when the `to` type is restricted for the person, an object of `from` is visible to them only when it links to a visible object of `to` (only a project Owner adds, changes or removes it, or changes the relationships it walks; Editors keep every other relationship)

inputs.description: a JSON Schema of type object (checked with tools.validate)

checks.description: the flow `when` shape (flows._holds) over {{ data.object.* }} and {{ data.inputs.* }}

confirm.description: the person confirms each run (old → new preview)

approval.description: the write is a proposal an Editor approves (approve_edit)

flow.description: a manual-trigger flow started with {{ data.trigger.object }} and {{ data.trigger.inputs }}
